title: meshcore_gateway_adapter ztest: stack overflow in test_send_channel_text_allows_external_emit_after_ack
description: On AWS waves-base (native_sim/native/64, gcc 11.5, hardened flags), lichen/tests/meshcore_gateway_adapter now BUILDS (after worker6-b86j switch-enum fixes: hal_bridge.c cases + meshcore/adapter.c:396 LICHEN_MESHCORE_PENDING_MAX case) — the image could not compile at all before. ztest run: 13 tests PASS, then test_send_channel_text_allows_external_emit_after_ack dies with 'ZEPHYR FATAL ERROR 2: Stack overflow on CPU 0' (idle thread, stack-protector @ kernel/compiler_stack_protect.c:39). Not caused by the switch-case fixes (case label has no runtime effect; suite was previously unbuildable/unrunnable on this baseline). Likely needs larger ztest/idle stack in that test's prj.conf or a shallower call path in test_send_channel_text.
